text: And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

Thus shall it be done{H6213} for each{H259} bullock,{H7794} or for each{H259} ram,{H352} or for each of the he-lambs,{H3532} or of the kids.{H5795}

And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}
Speak{H1696} unto the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} and say{H559} unto them, When ye come{H935} into the land{H776} whither I bring{H935} you,

And when ye shall err,{H7686} and not observe{H6213} all these commandments,{H4687} which Jehovah{H3068} hath spoken{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872}

And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H559} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

Speak{H1696} unto the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} and bid{H559} them that they make{H6213} them fringes{H6734} in the borders{H3671} of their garments{H899} throughout their generations,{H1755} and that they put{H5414} upon the fringe{H6734} of each border{H3671} a cord{H6616} of blue:{H8504}

I am Jehovah{H3068} your God,{H430} who brought you out{H3318} of the land{H776} of Egypt,{H4714} to be your God:{H430} I am Jehovah{H3068} your God.{H430}
